An '''analysis station''' stood near the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Orbital Deployment Center]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[O'reen]]. A group of [[O'reenian]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] analyzed a piece of stolen military hardware there on one occasion under the supervision of a [[Unidentified O'reenian military supervisor|military supervisor]]. Eventually, the supervisor received orders to move the hardware to the planetary capital, [[Fort Maximus]].
